title: laurembergia zeylanica var. minor
intro: Laurembergia zeylanica var. minor, commonly known as 'Sri Lankan laurel', is a species of flowering plant in the family Haloragaceae. It is traditionally used in Sri Lankan medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a valuable natural remedy. The bioactive constituents of Laurembergia zeylanica var. minor include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
